title: All 5 genetic “letters” of DNA and RNA discovered in a 4.5-billion-year-old asteroid
caption:
Scientists have confirmed that all five essential building blocks for DNA and RNA are present in samples from the asteroid Ryugu. This discovery reinforces the idea that the ingredients for life were widespread throughout our early solar system.

Source: Sciencedaily - All 5 genetic “letters” of DNA and RNA discovered in a 4.5-billion-year-old asteroid

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261102075903.htm
